requirements.quote:
To avoid excessive route flapping, a BGP speaker that needs to
   withdraw a destination and send an update about a more specific or
   less specific route should combine them into the same UPDATE message.
requirements.condition: A BGP speaker needs to withdraw a destination and send an update about a more specific or less specific route.
requirements.required_behavior: The speaker should combine the withdrawal and the route update into the same UPDATE message to avoid excessive route flapping.
requirements.why_checkable: UPDATE construction can be inspected to determine whether a pending withdrawal and related more-specific or less-specific route advertisement are combined in one message.
